title: Scene Evidence Bundle
description: Describes the evidence artifacts captured for a single scene during a regression run. Stored at out/evidence/scenes/<scene_id>/bundle.json.

screenshot.description: Relative path to screenshot within bundle directory

sram.description: Relative path to SRAM within bundle directory. For V2 projects this is the canonical technical evidence when it carries the MDRT block.

vdp_dump.description: Relative path to historical visual_vdp_dump.bin when produced by legacy VLAB-compatible flows. Optional for current V2 pipelines.

expected_app_scene_id.description: App scene ID that was expected based on regression manifest

captured_app_scene_id.description: App scene ID actually captured via MDRT block in SRAM

scene_verification_required.description: Whether scene verification via MDRT was required

scene_match.description: Whether captured scene matches expected scene

ready_heartbeat_ok.description: Whether the readiness heartbeat was detected in SRAM

mdrt_present.description: Whether a valid MDRT block was found in SRAM

artifacts_captured.description: Canonical list of artifact labels captured
